propositions: The per-event oracle in the authorship batched-map test returns None from a single resolve_event_commit call when a transient Git read error occurs, while the batched side recovers after retry, causing equivalence assertions to fail.

Production resolve_event_commit deliberately maps all Git errors and empty results to None and must retain fail-closed semantics; transient recovery must be confined to the test fixture, not production code.
A test-local bounded helper with up to five identical retries of resolve_event_commit is required to match the batched resolver's transient handling and return only non-None exact SHAs.
Persistent per-event oracle failures must stop after exactly five attempts and raise diagnostics with fsck and count-objects evidence without weakening exact position-to-SHA equivalence assertions.
